title: Penguin Month
lines: Penguin Month is open until 5 January. Its top prize is Yule. Flurry, Pomp, Larp, Jet and Dibs are featured. Half the pulls of their rarity give one of them.
In The Little Raid, Huddle is a new origin: Huddle figures that start the fight touching share one shield. The Carving Knife is a new component that turns up after a boss.

more.head: Leaving every raid
points: Leaving now: Hodge, Glorp, Drizzle, Eaves and Dose. You can still pull them at the Grove, and buy them in raids with your own figures.
Groot Night has closed. You can only buy the Commodore in raids with your own figures, if you pulled him.

more.head: New figures
points: Dibs (1 acorn, Huddle Bulwark) shields itself and the most hurt friend touching it: 90 for 4 seconds.
Jet (2 acorns, Huddle Sneak) slides in a line through its target. Every enemy on the line takes 100 physical damage.
Jet leaves ice on the line for 3 seconds. Enemies on the ice are 30% slower.
Larp (3 acorns, Gnome Slinger, and Huddle) throws 4 snowballs, each at a different enemy if it can. Each does 55 physical damage.
Flurry (4 acorns, Huddle Sage) brings snow for 4 seconds. It falls on the enemy in reach with the most enemies touching it, and the hexes touching that one.
Enemies in Flurry's snow take 60 magic damage a second and are 25% slower.
Pomp (4 acorns, Gnome Chorus) gives every friend in its row 30 mana. They attack 25% faster for 4 seconds.
Yule (5 acorns, Huddle Mender, and LHZ) is Penguin Month's top prize. It puts the most hurt friend in a bubble for 2 seconds.
Nothing can hurt a friend in the bubble, and they can't act. They come out with 520 health back and a full mana bar.
Each later cast bubbles 1 more friend, up to 3.
While Penguin Month is open, anyone can buy Yule in any raid.

more.head: Traits
points: New origin: LHZ. Yule is one.
One LHZ figure starts the fight with 15 more mana. Two start with 25 more each.
With two, each time one uses its ability, the other gets 15 mana.
The Honorary Badge is a new charm. The figure holding it counts as LHZ.
Huddle, with 2 and 4: Huddle figures that start the fight touching share one shield. It is worth 25% or 35% of their health added together.
Huddle, with 5: the shield comes back once, 6 seconds after it breaks. It is then worth 35% of the health of those still standing.
Sage has a third step at 6. Abilities are 90% stronger, and each attack gives 7 more mana.
Chorus has a fourth step at 5. The party gains 4 mana a second, and Chorus figures 8.

more.head: Items
points: After you beat a boss, the second component pick always has a Carving Knife.
A Knife and any other component make a class emblem. The emblem keeps that component's stat.
The five: Wooden Tooth (Thorn, Fang), Wooden Sling (Plume, Slinger), Wooden Spectacles (Glowcap, Sage), Wooden Buckler (Bark, Bulwark) and Wooden Spoon (Chestnut, Mender).
Two Knives make An Extra Chair.
Guild Onesie is a new charm. The figure holding it counts as Huddle.
